kb_proposals: Uniform ε over a finite family without a nonemptiness case split: δ = 1/(1 + Σ 1/ε_i) is positive and ≤ every ε_i (for finitely supported families, sum over (f − g).support; off it f i − g i = 0) — used in Chapter3/AlphaSomme.

α(W) on a sum of convex sets: the « seulement si » needs no extra decomposition lemma — x = (1/(1+ε)) z + (ε/(1+ε)) y is a second decomposition of x, and injectivity of p on ∏ V_i gives z_i = x_i + ε(x_i − y_i).
notes: One new file, no sorry, standard axioms; lake build of the module built only it (no upstream rebuild). Import line appended to scaffold/BenzecriScaffold.lean. The anchor is the finite-index alphaW_somme_iff; alphaW_sommeInfinie_iff (IsSommeInfinie, finitely supported families) is proved but rests on T-bz-c3-sommes's reading of Remarque 2 and must not be the anchor. The three helper lemmas are small and general; they may be made private at graduation if preferred.
